name: arabic-carousel
description: Arabic RTL carousels, single posts and 9:16 reels for Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook: writes the copy and builds an offline editor with PNG, ZIP, PDF and video export that keeps Arabic letters joined and mixed Arabic/English/numbers in order.

interface.shortDescription: Arabic carousels, posts and reels with correct RTL text
interface.longDescription: Describe a topic and get a ready Arabic carousel: the skill writes the slides and delivers one offline HTML editor to tweak text, colours, fonts and formats (4:5, 1:1, 9:16), then export PNG, ZIP in posting order, a LinkedIn PDF, or an animated 9:16 reel. Arabic letters stay joined and mixed Arabic, English and numbers keep their order in every export.
